name: RFC Toolkit
description: Structured technical-design (RFC) skills: task-type-aware planning guides and output templates, a self-critique checklist, and a syntax-safe Mermaid diagram generator. Ported from the aiden-plugins arch bundle with vendor-specific tooling removed. Desktop only; install it with the Cognia CLI (see README).
author: cognia-next

browser.reason: Skill bundles are read from the plugin directory through the desktop filesystem bridge.

mobile.reason: Skill bundles are read from the plugin directory through the desktop filesystem bridge.

skills.name: RFC: write a design plan
skills.description: Write a technical proposal, design doc, or structured plan for a bug fix, new feature, or refactor: loads the matching task guide and template, researches the codebase, and writes the document to the path you give.

skills.name: RFC: critique a proposal
skills.description: Critically review a draft design or RFC for completeness, soundness, and whether the gathered knowledge is sufficient and correctly applied.

skills.name: Mermaid diagrams
skills.description: Generate syntactically correct, cleanly laid-out Mermaid diagrams (flowcharts, sequence, state, and more).
